//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the SECTION container — the lightweight `.pa-section` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.section/1`, svelte `layout/Section.svelte`). SCOPE = INLINE CONTAINER. Canonical shape from snippets/cards.html (lines 561-571) + _cards.scss (.pa-section): a <div class="pa-section"> wrapping an OPTIONAL bare <h3> title (styled by the CHILD selector `.pa-section > h3` — there is NO `pa-section__title` element class) followed by arbitrary content (the slot). The block has ZERO modifiers (no `.pa-section--*` in main.css) and ZERO element classes (the h3 is a bare child, not `.pa-section__*`). NOTE the SIBLING `.pa-section-title` is a DIFFERENT, standalone component (svelte `layout/SectionTitle.svelte`; keen has no dedicated fn) for a heading placed OUTSIDE a section — OUT OF SCOPE here. The title inside a section must be a bare <h3>.

propsVocabulary.title: optional section heading — rendered as a BARE <h3> (styled via `.pa-section > h3`), NOT a `.pa-section-title` and NOT a `.pa-section__title`. Omit → no <h3> at all.
propsVocabulary.body: the section's content area — filled with plain slot text in this slice (real children would be cards/grids). Always present after the optional title.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the section adds no attribute conventions like button's type. The title is a BARE <h3> (child-selector styling, no class). The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + the optional bare h3 + nesting, not rich content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-section BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (grep '\.pa-section--' on main.css is empty) and ZERO element classes (the only styled descendant is `.pa-section > h3`, a BARE child — no `pa-section__*` exists). So the container contract is minimal: the base class + an optional bare-<h3> title + a body slot + a class passthrough. `produces: null` everywhere — the title is structural (a bare h3, no class), not a class-producing feature. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is block-modifier-scoped (pa-section--*), of which there are none.

title.note: structural — rendered as a BARE <h3>, styled by the child selector `.pa-section > h3`; no element class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: The sibling `.pa-section-title` is a SEPARATE standalone component (svelte SectionTitle.svelte), not an element of this block — it does not match `pa-section--*` or `pa-section__*`, so capability.mjs never sees it as part of this fixture's surface. Nothing to defer: the .pa-section block has no sub-element or modifier classes of its own.

scenarios.name: title-and-body
scenarios.note: The blessed shape: a bare <h3> heading (styled via `.pa-section > h3`) above the content.

scenarios.name: body-only
scenarios.note: No title → NO <h3> at all; the container never emits an empty heading.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-section; token order is normalized away.
